svg.title: Each of the 3 k-means clusters found on four biometry measurements, drawn as a horizontal band against gestational age, a variable the clustering never saw. The bands sort by mean and very nearly tile the measured interval.
svg.text: the algorithm never saw the dates. look what it found.
the labels account for 0.871 of the variation in gestational age
clustered on BPD, HC, AC and FL. gestational age was never shown to the algorithm.
